# Watchbear

> Watchbear is a free Chrome extension for watch parties. It keeps video playback in sync for everyone in a room on YouTube, Netflix, Vimeo and most sites with a standard video player, with live chat, reactions, and free voice and video chat in a side panel.

Install it from the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/watchbear-watch-together/ldegfikaldilbcpgmiopdnnhpkpcnepn. Start a room on a video, share the room code, and friends join after signing in with a free Google account.

## Docs

- [Watchbear](https://watchbear.net/): what the extension does, supported sites and FAQ
- [Teleparty alternative](https://watchbear.net/teleparty-alternative.html): Watchbear vs Teleparty on supported sites, video chat, price and phones, including where Teleparty is stronger
- [Support](https://watchbear.net/support.html): help and contact
- [Privacy policy](https://watchbear.net/privacy.html): what data the extension and site handle

## Blog

- [Blog](https://watchbear.net/blog/): guides for watching together online
- [Why your watch party keeps going out of sync, and how to fix it](https://watchbear.net/blog/why-watch-party-out-of-sync.html): Buffering, ads, stray pauses and manual countdowns all push friends apart. What causes the drift, and how to stop it for good.
- [How to watch YouTube together with friends online](https://watchbear.net/blog/watch-youtube-together.html): Screen sharing, calls and sync extensions compared, plus a step-by-step setup and a few ideas for what to put on.
- [Long-distance movie night: 10 ideas that feel like hanging out](https://watchbear.net/blog/long-distance-movie-night-ideas.html): Themes, rituals and small games that make a movie night over the internet feel less like a call and more like a night in.
- [How to watch Netflix together online with friends](https://watchbear.net/blog/how-to-watch-netflix-together-online.html): What everyone needs, why screen sharing Netflix rarely works, and how to keep a whole group on the same scene from the opening credits on.
- [How to stream Netflix on Discord, and why the screen goes black](https://watchbear.net/blog/screen-share-movie-discord-zoom.html): The Discord steps, why Netflix shows up as a black screen, and what works better for a whole film.
- [How to host an online watch party that actually stays in sync](https://watchbear.net/blog/how-to-host-a-watch-party-online.html): Skip the "3, 2, 1, play" countdown. What you need, how to set up the room, and how to fix the usual problems before anyone notices them.
